title: Themia
shortDescription: Widgets that live on your Windows desktop: clock, weather, calendar, mail, tasks, system meters, files and more, on your wallpaper and behind your windows. 80 widgets, free to start, no ads, no account.
description: Themia puts widgets on the desktop itself: on your wallpaper, behind your windows. They are always a glance away and never in the way. There is no window to open and no icon in the tray, only your desktop with what you want to see on it.
80 WIDGETS
• Clock, alarms, timers, stopwatch, countdown and Pomodoro
• Weather now and for the week, rain in the next hour, air quality, sun and moon
• Calendar, week planner, next meeting, mail, tasks, contacts and notes
• Processor, memory, graphics, disks, network, ping and battery, with live graphs
• Folders, shortcuts, your newest files, drives and the Recycle Bin
• Music, volume, the mixer, brightness and quick settings such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and night light
• Stocks, exchange rates, news feeds, screen time, habits, photos and more
YOUR DAY ON YOUR DESKTOP

See your next meeting and join it with one click. Read new mail, tick off tasks and look at your week without opening an app. Themia works with Microsoft accounts (Outlook.com, Microsoft 365), iCloud, any IMAP mail account, and CalDAV and CardDAV servers such as Fastmail or Nextcloud.
WIDGETS THAT FIT THE ROOM YOU GIVE THEM

Make a widget small and it keeps what matters. Make it bigger and it shows more: the weather grows from a temperature to the whole day, a meter from a number to its history. Nothing is cut off and nothing is stretched.
ONE WIDGET, MANY STYLES
A clock can be digital, analogue, a flip clock or written out in words. Meters come as graphs, bars, rings and gauges, forecasts as rows or a curve. Pick the style from the widget's own menu.
ARRANGE IT YOUR WAY

Press Ctrl+Alt+W or double-click a widget to edit your desktop. Add widgets from the list, drag them where you want them, resize them and let them snap to a grid. Every option of a widget sits right beside it, and every step can be undone.
A LOOK FOR EVERY WALLPAPER

Start from a preset such as Glass, Midnight or Paper, or mix your own: colours, transparency, borders, corners and fonts. Each widget can have its own background, and Themia follows the light or dark theme of Windows.
A DESKTOP FOR EVERY PART OF YOUR DAY

Views keep several desktops ready: one for work with your calendar and mail, one for the evening with music and photos, one for focus with nothing but a timer. Switch with a click, and give every display its own.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Themia has no ads, no tracking, no analytics and no account of its own. Mail, calendars and tasks connect straight from your PC to your provider; nothing passes through us. Your sign-ins are encrypted by Windows for your Windows user alone.
LIGHT ON YOUR PC
Built natively for Windows 11 and compiled ahead of time, Themia starts fast, uses little memory and does no work while nothing changes.
FREE TO START
Every widget and every setting is in the free version, with up to 20 widgets and 2 views. Themia Pro, one purchase in Themia through the Microsoft Store, lifts both limits for good. No subscription.
In 40 languages. Weather data by Open-Meteo.com.
